title: 'High-performance' artificial reef transforms town's surf scene | ABC News
what_it_shows: ABC News television segment on the Southern Ocean Surf Reef ('Midds Reef') opening at Middleton Beach, Albany. Shows surfers riding the reef, interviews advocate Peter Bolt (30-year campaign) and a local surfer on wave quality, and covers the AUD $13 million cost and funding sources. Companion piece to the ABC News written article (dossier R2).
key_quotes: 00:29 - Peter Bolt: "I think I came back to Albany in 1990. We just felt that's where we needed the juniors to have something decent to surf... in town where they can get access to it."
01:13 - narration: "...saying the beach is holding up just fine and it was worth every cent."
01:27 - local surfer: "...this wave is that. It's a really high performance wave."
01:34 - Peter Bolt: "When I see the kids come down here before school, in the dark, to get a wave before they go to school, and then they zip down here again after school..."

title: Albany Artificial Surf Reef Project
what_it_shows: Official City of Albany community-consultation/project video from 2020 (pre-construction, during the detailed design phase), explaining the Artificial Surf Reef proposal for Middleton Beach and its expected economic/tourism benefits. Concept/planning-stage video, not footage of the built reef (construction only began in 2025). Companion captioned version exists at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yZWJj8_uE9Y ('No Subtitles' variant, same content).
